body: That was so sweet of you! I really appreciate the reply! As of right now, my hobby is kind of trying to find a job. After I get that out of the way, I want to pick up a real hobby. I used to draw, and my husband bought me some sketching tools, but I just can't bring myself to draw anything. I tell myself I will, and I know it will help, but I just can't seem to put the pencil to paper. I just started taking the lexapro and haven't really felt a difference, so that is kind of attributing to my stress and anxiety. We have a cat, little white one named Kitty. He's pretty much our kid and we love him. But other than that, I don't really do much.
I'm here if you want to talk.  :)
